text:
elaine: handing off night -> swing. I'm primary for the next 8h, @rahul will be secondary. Quick health snapshot: live traffic at ~60% baseline, no ongoing incidents. AWS accounts: prod-main and prod-logging. Grafana dashboards are green except `inference-latency-prod` which has a small blip (5m p95 spike to 420ms) tied to a single shard — I scaled the podset earlier. :white_check_mark:

elaine: access checklist (do these before accepting):
- PagerDuty: verify you can see Redwood Inference -> "prod" escalation policy and trigger test alert (non-PII test).
- AWS: confirm `arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/Redwood-Oncall` assumable and run `aws sts get-caller-identity` after assume-role.
- Grafana: confirm you can view `inference-latency-prod` and annotate if you see sustained spikes.
- Runbooks: open internal runbook link: https://internal.redwood/runbooks/oncall-handoff (read-only).

rahul: taking secondary, will verify access now.

rahul: PagerDuty ok, I can see the prod escalation policy. Triggered a test alert (no notify to users). Ops-bot reported ACK.

ops-bot: PagerDuty test alert: PD-TEST-877 acknowledged by rahul :white_check_mark:

sam: quick note — I still don't have grafana access from my laptop (403). I filed a ticket with infra but can you confirm the org team is in the viewer group?

elaine: sam, viewer group should be `grafana-viewers@redwood`. If you see 403 it's probably SSO mapping. Try `Profile -> Organization -> Switch Org` first. If that fails, open this minimal command for infra to debug: 
```
curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $GRAF_TOKEN" https://grafana.internal/api/org/users | jq .
```

rahul: AWS assume-role step (copy/paste):
```
aws sts assume-role --role-arn arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/Redwood-Oncall --role-session-name oncall-session
# then export creds and run
aws sts get-caller-identity
```
I got `Account: 123456789012` and ARN showing `assumed-role/Redwood-Oncall/rahul` — looks good.

morgan: FYI, there's a slight coverage gap between 02:00-03:00 UTC where we don't have APAC-linked backup. If anything pages in APAC during that window, escalate to the APAC rotation channel and ping the oncall-swappers doc: https://internal.redwood/docs/oncall-swaps

elaine: noted. If APAC pages between 02:00-03:00 UTC, primary handles first 10m then escalate to oncall-swappers; put an annotation in PagerDuty incident with `#apac-gap`.

sam: infra responded — it's SSO mapping for your Okta group, so they added `sam@redwood` to `grafana-viewers`. Please re-check.

sam: confirmed, Grafana access restored. Can see inference-latency-prod and added an annotation at 2024-11-21T00:23Z about the p95 blip.

rahul: small follow-ups before I mark accepted:
1) Confirm 1Password section for oncall keys: `Oncall/Prod/AssumeRole` has current role arn + MFA instructions.
2) Runbook for Live Mitigation: quicklinks in the handoff runbook point to `runbook/inference/latency-spikes` — the steps are: cache flush, scale shard, check kv-cache hit rate.

elaine: 1) 1Password entry present. 2) Confirmed — runbook also has a quick `kubectl` snippet for scaling: 
```
kubectl -n inference scale statefulset inference-shard-3 --replicas=3
```
Do that only if latency stays high for >10m and p95 > 400ms.

ops-bot: incident-bot detected a threshold crossing at 2170000058: inference-latency-prod p95 > 400ms for 3m — auto-notify sent to #eng-oncall and PagerDuty.

rahul: saw that. I scaled inference-shard-3 to 3 replicas at 2170000072. Watching.

elaine: after scaling, watch the KV cache hit rate — scaling can cause cold-cache blips. If error rate increases, rollback to 2 replicas and open an incident.

rahul: p95 back to ~180ms after ~45s, KV cache hit rate recovered. No error spike. Marking handoff accepted. I'm now primary. Sam you're secondary?

sam: confirmed, I'm secondary and reachable. I put a quick note in the handoff runbook: "accepted by rahul, APAC gap 02:00-03:00 UTC".

elaine: great handoff. Leaving the bridge link in the runbook in case something reappears. Good luck y'all :coffee: 

rahul: thanks! I'll ping if anything else.

morgan: logging a short post-handoff note for SRE lead: scaled shard briefly, no regression.

ops-bot: handoff-complete: outgoing=elaine, incoming=rahul, secondary=sam, notes="APAC coverage gap 02:00-03:00 UTC; scaled inference-shard-3 temporarily; Grafana/SMS tests pass"
